casual.title: ☕ 1. Starbucks Special Requests & Coffee Customization
casual.subtitle: 星巴克与精品咖啡特调点餐（母语者级）

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like an iced oat milk latte with two pumps of sugar-free vanilla syrup, please.
sentences.cn: 嗨，请给我来一杯冰燕麦奶拿铁，加两泵无糖香草糖浆。
sentences.ipa: /haɪ, aɪd laɪk ən aɪst oʊt mɪlk ˈlɑːteɪ wɪð tuː pʌmps əv ˈʃʊɡər friː vəˈnɪlə ˈsɪrəp, pliːz/

sentences.en: Could you make it light ice and add a cold foam on top?
sentences.cn: 可以做成少冰，并且在上面加一层冷奶泡吗？
sentences.ipa: /kʊd juː meɪk ɪt laɪt aɪs ænd æd ə koʊld foʊm ɑːn tɑːp/

sentences.en: Sure! Would you like an extra shot of espresso to make it stronger?
sentences.cn: 没问题！您需要额外加一份意式浓缩让口感更浓郁吗？
sentences.ipa: /ʃʊr! wʊd juː laɪk ən ˈekstrə ʃɑːt əv eˈspresoʊ tuː meɪk ɪt ˈstrɔːŋɡər/

sentences.en: That would be awesome. Please put it under the name Alex.
sentences.cn: 那太棒了。杯子上请写名字 Alex，谢谢。
sentences.ipa: /ðæt wʊd biː ˈɔːsəm. pliːz pʊt ɪt ˈʌndər ðə neɪm ˈælɪks/

casual.title: 🍔 2. Drive-Thru Ordering & Secret Menu
casual.subtitle: 美式得来速与隐藏菜单点餐

sentences.en: Welcome to In-N-Out! What can I get started for you today?
sentences.cn: 欢迎来到 In-N-Out！今天为您点些什么？
sentences.ipa: /ˈwelkəm tuː ɪn ænd aʊt! wʌt kæn aɪ ɡet ˈstɑːrtɪd fɔːr juː təˈdeɪ/

sentences.en: Can I get a Double-Double animal style, with well-done fries?
sentences.cn: 请给我一份双层牛肉芝士汉堡主厨秘制款（Animal Style），薯条要炸到特别酥脆的。
sentences.ipa: /kæn aɪ ɡet ə ˈdʌbl ˈdʌbl ˈænɪml staɪl, wɪð wel dʌn fraɪz/

sentences.en: Got it! Anything to drink with your combo meal?
sentences.cn: 收到！您的套餐需要搭配什么饮料吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɡɑːt ɪt! ˈeniθɪŋ tuː drɪŋk wɪð jʊər ˈkɑːmboʊ miːl/

sentences.en: I'll take a chocolate milkshake. Please pull up to the second window.
sentences.cn: 我要一杯巧克力奶昔。请把车开到第二个窗口结账取餐。
sentences.ipa: /aɪl teɪk ə ˈtʃɑːklət ˈmɪlkʃeɪk. pliːz pʊl ʌp tuː ðə ˈsekənd ˈwɪndoʊ/

casual.title: 🌴 3. Weekend Relaxation & Outdoor Camping
casual.subtitle: 聊聊周末露营与户外放松

sentences.en: Are you up for a weekend camping trip near the lake?
sentences.cn: 这个周末你有兴趣去湖边露营吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɑːr juː ʌp fɔːr ə ˈwiːkend ˈkæmpɪŋ trɪp nɪər ðə leɪk/

sentences.en: Count me in! I'll bring the s'mores and portable speaker.
sentences.cn: 算我一个！我会带上棉花糖夹心饼干和便携音箱。
sentences.ipa: /kaʊnt miː ɪn! aɪl brɪŋ ðə s'mores ænd ˈpɔːrtəbl ˈspiːkər/

sentences.en: Don't forget to pack insect repellent and a warm sleeping bag.
sentences.cn: 别忘了带上防蚊喷雾和保暖睡袋。
sentences.ipa: /doʊnt fərˈɡet tuː pæk ˈɪnsekt rɪˈpelənt ænd ə wɔːrm ˈsliːpɪŋ bæɡ/

casual.title: 🎬 4. Movies, Binge-Watching & Spoilers
casual.subtitle: 聊电影、追美剧与防止剧透

sentences.en: Did you binge-watch the new season of Stranger Things last night?
sentences.cn: 你昨晚连夜追完《怪奇物语》最新一季了吗？
sentences.ipa: /dɪd juː bɪndʒ wɑːtʃ ðə nuː ˈsiːzn əv Stranger Things læst naɪt/

sentences.en: I finished five episodes! The cliffhanger at the end blew my mind.
sentences.cn: 我一口气看了五集！结尾的悬念简直颠覆我的想象。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt faɪv ˈepɪsoʊdz! ðə ˈklɪfhæŋər æt ðə end bluː maɪ maɪnd/

sentences.en: No spoilers please! I'm only on episode two.
sentences.cn: 请千万不要剧透！我才看到第二集呢。
sentences.ipa: /noʊ ˈspɔɪlərz pliːz! aɪm ˈoʊnli ɑːn ˈepɪsoʊd tuː/

casual.title: 🛒 5. Grocery Shopping & Organic Produce
casual.subtitle: 超市生鲜挑选与定位探寻

sentences.en: Excuse me, which aisle is the gluten-free bread located in?
sentences.cn: 打扰一下，请问无麸质面包在哪个过道？
sentences.ipa: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː, wɪtʃ aɪl ɪz ðə ˈɡluːtn friː bred loʊˈkeɪtɪd ɪn/

sentences.en: It's in aisle three, right next to the organic dairy products.
sentences.cn: 在第三过道，就在有机乳制品隔壁。
sentences.ipa: /ɪts ɪn aɪl θriː, raɪt nekst tuː ðə ɔːrˈɡænɪk ˈderi ˈprɑːdʌkts/

sentences.en: Is there a discount on these avocados if I buy a box?
sentences.cn: 如果我买一整盒这种牛油果，有折扣优惠吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɪz ðer ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɑːn ðiːz ˌævəˈkɑːdoʊz ɪf aɪ baɪ ə bɑːks/

casual.title: 🍻 6. Happy Hour & Bar Socializing
casual.subtitle: 酒吧 Happy Hour 点酒与破冰社交

sentences.en: Is this seat taken, or mind if I grab a chair?
sentences.cn: 这个位置有人吗，介意我拉把椅子坐这里吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɪz ðɪs siːt ˈteɪkən, ɔːr maɪnd ɪf aɪ ɡræb ə tʃer/

sentences.en: Not at all! Bartender, another IPA on tap for my friend here.
sentences.cn: 完全不介意！调酒师，给我的朋友来一杯扎啤 IPA。
sentences.ipa: /nɑːt æt ɔːl! ˈbɑːrtendər, əˈnʌðər IPA ɑːn tæp fɔːr maɪ frend hɪər/

sentences.en: Cheers to Friday night and good company!
sentences.cn: 为周五夜晚和绝妙的同伴干杯！
sentences.ipa: /tʃɪərz tuː ˈfraɪdeɪ naɪt ænd ɡʊd ˈkʌmpəni/

casual.title: 🏠 7. Apartment Renting & Lease Agreement
casual.subtitle: 美式租房看房与签署 Lease 协议

sentences.en: Is the security deposit refundable upon moving out?
sentences.cn: 搬走时押金是全额退还的吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɪz ðə sɪˈkjʊrəti dɪˈpɑːzɪt rɪˈfʌndəbl əˈpɑːn ˈmuːvɪŋ aʊt/

sentences.en: Yes, provided there is no major damage to the property.
sentences.cn: 是的，只要对房间设施没有重大损坏。
sentences.ipa: /jes, prəˈvaɪdɪd ðer ɪz noʊ ˈmeɪdʒər ˈdæmɪdʒ tuː ðə ˈprɑːpərti/

sentences.en: Are pets allowed in the building?
sentences.cn: 大楼里允许养宠物吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɑːr pets əˈlaʊd ɪn ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/

casual.title: 🍕 8. Ordering Pizza & Venmo Bill Splitting
casual.subtitle: 美式聚会点披萨与 Venmo 分账

sentences.en: Let's order two large pepperoni pizzas and garlic knots.
sentences.cn: 我们点两份大号意式香肠披萨和大蒜面包结吧。
sentences.ipa: /lets ˈɔːrdər tuː lɑːrdʒ ˌpepəˈroʊni ˈpiːtsəz ænd ˈɡɑːrlɪk nɑːts/

sentences.en: Just Venmo me your share once the delivery arrives.
sentences.cn: 外卖一到，直接用 Venmo 把你那份转给我就行。
sentences.ipa: /dʒʌst Venmo miː jʊər ʃer wʌns ðə dɪˈlɪvəri əˈraɪvz/

casual.title: 🏃 9. Gym Workout & Personal Training
casual.subtitle: 健身房锻炼与私人教练计划

sentences.en: Are you using this squat rack, or can I work in?
sentences.cn: 你在用这个蹲腿架吗，我可以组间轮流一起用吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɑːr juː ˈjuːzɪŋ ðɪs skwɑːt ræk, ɔːr kæn aɪ wɜːrk ɪn/

sentences.en: Go ahead! I have one set left before finishing.
sentences.cn: 你用吧！我还有最后一组就练完了。
sentences.ipa: /ɡoʊ əˈhed! aɪ hæv wʌn set left bɪˈfɔːr ˈfɪnɪʃɪŋ/

casual.title: 💇 10. Hair Salon & Styling Preferences
casual.subtitle: 理发店剪发与造型需求表达

sentences.en: Just a trim on the sides, and keep some length on top, please.
sentences.cn: 两边修剪短一点，上面保留一点长度，谢谢。
sentences.ipa: /dʒʌst ə trɪm ɑːn ðə saɪdz, ænd kiːp sʌm leŋθ ɑːn tɑːp, pliːz/

sentences.en: Would you like a fade on the back?
sentences.cn: 后脑勺需要推一个渐变层（Fade）吗？
sentences.ipa: /wʊd juː laɪk ə feɪd ɑːn ðə bæk/

casual.title: 🐶 11. Pet Care, Vet Visit & Dog Walking
casual.subtitle: 宠物看兽医与遛狗日常对话

sentences.en: My Golden Retriever needs her annual vaccination shot today.
sentences.cn: 我的金毛寻回犬今天需要打年度疫苗。
sentences.ipa: /maɪ ˈɡoʊldən rɪˈtriːvər niːdz hɜːr ˈænjuəl ˌvæksɪˈneɪʃn ʃɑːt təˈdeɪ/

sentences.en: She is super friendly and loves chasing tennis balls in the park.
sentences.cn: 她特别友善，平时最喜欢在公园里追网球玩。
sentences.ipa: /ʃiː ɪz ˈsuːpər ˈfrendli ænd lʌvz ˈtʃeɪsɪŋ ˈtenɪs bɔːlz ɪn ðə pɑːrk/

casual.title: 🚗 12. Gas Station & Car Maintenance
casual.subtitle: 自助加油站与汽油号数选择

sentences.en: Fill it up with regular unleaded on pump number four, please.
sentences.cn: 四号加油枪，麻烦请帮我加满 87 号无铅汽油。
sentences.ipa: /fɪl ɪt ʌp wɪð ˈreɡjələr ʌnˈledɪd ɑːn pʌmp ˈnʌmbər fɔːr, pliːz/

sentences.en: Could you check my tire pressure and windshield wiper fluid?
sentences.cn: 能顺便帮我检查下胎压和雨刮水吗？
sentences.ipa: /kʊd juː tʃek maɪ taɪər ˈpreʃər ænd ˈwɪndʃiːld ˈwaɪpər ˈfluːɪd/

workplace.title: 💼 1. Elevator Pitch & Networking Event
workplace.subtitle: 硅谷高管级 30 秒电梯演讲与 Networking 社交

sentences.en: Hi! I'm Alex, leveraging generative AI to automate enterprise workflow automation.
sentences.cn: 你好！我是 Alex，目前正在利用生成式 AI 自动化赋能企业工作流。
sentences.ipa: /haɪ! aɪm ˈælɪks, ˈlevərɪdʒɪŋ ˈdʒenərətɪv AI tuː ˈɔːtəmeɪt ˈentərpraɪz ˈwɜːrkfloʊ/

sentences.en: We've reduced customer onboarding time by over sixty percent quarter-over-quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们成功将客户入职体验流程耗时环比降低了 60% 以上。
sentences.ipa: /wiːv rɪˈduːst ˈkʌstəmər ˈɑːnboʊrdɪŋ taɪm baɪ ˈoʊvər ˈsɪksti pərˈsent/

sentences.en: That is incredible traction! Let me grab your LinkedIn to stay connected.
sentences.cn: 那业务增长势头太惊人了！加个 LinkedIn 保持联系吧。
sentences.ipa: /ðæt ɪz ɪnˈkredəbl ˈtrækʃn! let miː ɡræb jʊər LinkedIn tuː steɪ kəˈnektɪd/

workplace.title: 📊 2. Product Sprint Planning & Daily Standup
workplace.subtitle: 科技公司敏捷开发、Sprint 站会与需求确认

sentences.en: Good morning team! Let's kick off our daily standup meeting.
sentences.cn: 大家早上好！我们开始今天的每日敏捷站会吧。
sentences.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ tiːm! lets kɪk ɔːf aʊər ˈdeɪli ˈstændʌp ˈmiːtɪŋ/

sentences.en: Yesterday I refactored the API authentication module. No blockers on my end.
sentences.cn: 昨天我重构了 API 鉴权模块。我这边目前没有任何阻碍卡点。
sentences.ipa: /ˈjestərdeɪ aɪ riːˈfæktərd ðə API ɔːˌθentɪˈkeɪʃn ˈmɑːdjuːl. noʊ ˈblɑːkərz ɑːn maɪ end/

sentences.en: Great! Let's ensure high test coverage before pushing to production.
sentences.cn: 太棒了！推上线前请确保有高比例的测试覆盖率。
sentences.ipa: /ɡreɪt! lets ɪnˈʃʊr haɪ test ˈkʌvərɪdʒ bɪˈfɔːr ˈpʊʃɪŋ tuː prəˈdʌkʃn/

workplace.title: 🔥 3. Salary Negotiation & Offer Counter
workplace.subtitle: 硅谷高薪 Offer 谈判与 Counteroffer 争论

sentences.en: Thank you for extending the job offer. I'm really thrilled about this team.
sentences.cn: 感谢贵公司发放该职位 Offer。我对加入该团队感到非常激动。
sentences.ipa: /θæŋk juː fɔːr ɪkˈstendɪŋ ðə dʒɑːb ˈɔːfər. aɪm ˈriːəli θrɪld əˈbaʊt ðɪs tiːm/

sentences.en: Based on my market value and competing offers, can we discuss stock equity compensation?
sentences.cn: 基于我的市场价值以及手头的竞争 Offer，我们能探讨下股票期权回报吗？
sentences.ipa: /beɪst ɑːn maɪ ˈmɑːrkɪt ˈvæljuː, kæn wiː dɪˈskʌs stɑːk ˈekwəti ˌkɑːmpenˈseɪʃn/

sentences.en: We can bump up your signing bonus by twenty percent to bridge the gap.
sentences.cn: 我们可以将您的签字费额外提升 20%，来弥补这部分的预期差距。
sentences.ipa: /wiː kæn bʌmp ʌp jʊər ˈsaɪnɪŋ ˈboʊnəs baɪ ˈtwenti pərˈsent tuː brɪdʒ ðə ɡæp/

workplace.title: 🧠 4. Brainstorming & Elegant Objections
workplace.subtitle: 高情商头脑风暴与优雅化解团队分歧

sentences.en: I completely see where you're coming from, but have we considered scalability?
sentences.cn: 我完全理解你的立足点与初衷，但我们是否有考虑到长期的架构扩展性呢？
sentences.ipa: /aɪ kəmˈpliːtli siː wer jʊər ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm, bʌt hæv wiː kənˈsɪdərd ˌskeɪləˈbɪləti/

sentences.en: That's a valid point. Let's run a quick A/B test to validate user feedback.
sentences.cn: 这是个很有说服力的要点。我们来做个快速 A/B 测试来验证用户反馈吧。
sentences.ipa: /ðæts ə ˈvælɪd pɔɪnt. lets rʌn ə kwɪk A/B test tuː ˈvælɪdeɪt ˈjuːzər ˈfiːdbæk/

workplace.title: 🚀 5. Startup Fundraising & VC Pitching
workplace.subtitle: 创业项目融资与风投 Pitch

sentences.en: Our monthly active user base grew three hundred percent year-over-year.
sentences.cn: 我们的月活跃用户基数同比暴涨了 300%。
sentences.ipa: /aʊər ˈmʌnθli ˈæktɪv ˈjuːzər beɪs ɡruː θriː ˈhʌndrəd pərˈsent jɪər oʊvər jɪər/

sentences.en: We are raising a Series A round to accelerate international expansion.
sentences.cn: 我们正在进行 A 轮融资，以加速拓展全球国际市场。
sentences.ipa: /wiː ɑːr ˈreɪzɪŋ ə ˈsɪriːz A raʊnd tuː əkˈseləreɪt ˌɪntərˈnæʃnəl ɪkˈspænʃn/

workplace.title: 📧 6. Email Alignment & Project Delivery
workplace.subtitle: 商务邮件对齐与交付时间节点确认

sentences.en: Please find attached the updated roadmap for your final review.
sentences.cn: 请查收附件中更新后的路线图供您最终审阅。
sentences.ipa: /pliːz faɪnd əˈtætʃt ðə ˌʌpˈdeɪtɪd ˈroʊdmæp fɔːr jʊər ˈfaɪnl rɪˈvjuː/

sentences.en: Let's touch base tomorrow to confirm the launch checklist.
sentences.cn: 我们明天碰一下，确认上线的 Checklist 清单。
sentences.ipa: /lets tʌtʃ beɪs təˈmɑːroʊ tuː kənˈfɜːrm ðə lɔːntʃ ˈtʃeklɪst/

travel.title: ✈️ 1. Flight Delay & Rebooking at Airport Desk
travel.subtitle: 美式机场航班延误拉扯与免费改签

sentences.en: My connecting flight to San Francisco was cancelled due to severe thunderstorm.
sentences.cn: 我飞往旧金山的转机航班因强雷暴天气被不幸取消了。
sentences.ipa: /maɪ kəˈnektɪŋ flaɪt tuː sæn frənˈsɪskoʊ wəz ˈkænsld duː tuː sɪˈvɪər ˈθʌndərstɔːrm/

sentences.en: I can rebook you on the next available direct flight at no extra charge.
sentences.cn: 我可以免费帮您改签到下一班有空位的直飞航班。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ kæn riːˈbʊk juː ɑːn ðə nekst əˈveɪləbl dəˈrekt flaɪt æt noʊ ˈekstrə tʃɑːrdʒ/

sentences.en: Could you also provide me with a meal voucher and hotel accommodation?
sentences.cn: 您还能为我提供一张餐券以及今晚的酒店住宿安排吗？
sentences.ipa: /kʊd juː ˈɔːlsoʊ prəˈvaɪd miː wɪð ə miːl ˈvaʊtʃər ænd hoʊˈtel əˌkɑːməˈdeɪʃn/

travel.title: 🚘 2. Renting a Car at Hertz & Insurance Choice
travel.subtitle: Hertz 海外租车、车型升级与全险选择

sentences.en: I reserved a full-size SUV for a one-week California road trip.
sentences.cn: 我预订了一辆全尺寸 SUV，准备去加州自驾游玩一周。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ rɪˈzɜːrvd ə fʊl saɪz SUV fɔːr ə wʌn wiːk road trip/

sentences.en: Would you like to add full collision damage waiver coverage for peace of mind?
sentences.cn: 为了出行安心，您是否需要添加全额碰撞险（CDW）保障？
sentences.ipa: /wʊd juː laɪk tuː æd fʊl kəˈlɪʒn ˈdæmɪdʒ ˈweɪvər ˈkʌvərɪdʒ fɔːr piːs əv maɪnd/

travel.title: 🚑 3. Urgent Care & Hospital ER Consultation
travel.subtitle: 海外紧急看病 Urgent Care 与医生求助
